_about: Per-program-brand constants for the program card (rendering contract v1.7, design of record docs/design/program-card-design-v1.md). READ, NEVER COMPUTED AT RENDER TIME - the endcap's brand bar, the mirrored stage wash and the subtitle tint all key off `color` here. `mark` null means the tree has no art for this brand: the endcap renders `short_title` as a typographic mark on the charcoal tile instead, and the brand is an open item for the marks pipeline. `provisional: true` means the COLOUR is a placeholder too - nothing in this repo could be derived from, and a network's brand hex typed from memory is an invented fact.
